summary: Full backend + frontend testing for LinkChat. 19/19 pytest backend tests pass covering auth (signup/login/me/duplicate/google-session errors), profile update + persistence, servers (create with default geral+random channels, list-mine-only, non-member 403, join by code / invalid 404, create channel), channel messages (post, fetch with author enrichment, base64 image, empty rejection), DMs (all-users list excludes self, send+read both sides, non-existent user 404). Frontend end-to-end verified via Playwright: landing hero renders and 'Entrar' navigates to /auth; signup via UI lands on /app; create-server modal creates server with default 'geral' and 'random' channels; message sent appears in chat; member shown online in sidebar; DM rail switches to DM view, user list loads, selecting a user and sending message works end-to-end.

issues: Success toasts (e.g. 'Servidor criado!', 'Conta criada!') overlap with channel header area at top-center — low-impact but can briefly cover header title.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses `@app.on_event('shutdown')` which is deprecated in modern FastAPI — prefer lifespan context manager (minor).
`create_session` always sets cookie with secure=True + samesite='none' — correct for the HTTPS preview, but will not work on plain HTTP localhost dev.
No index on frequently-queried fields (users.email, user_sessions.session_token, messages.channel_id, servers.invite_code). Add Mongo indexes for scale.
Image attachments are stored as base64 inside Mongo documents — fine for MVP but will balloon doc size; migrate to object storage later.

Presence relies solely on last_seen updated inside get_current_user; a passive user with an open tab but no API traffic will appear offline after 45s. The 2.5s polling mitigates this, but consider explicit heartbeat usage in frontend.
test_credentials: alice@test.com / pass1234 (seeded in DB); signup accepts any new email.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed users/servers (not cleaned up to allow retest reuse). alice@test.com present.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_linkchat_backend.py — uses pytest-xdist loadscope so each class is self-contained (TestMessages has its own msg_ctx fixture). Fresh user per module via _signup(). Google OAuth cannot be fully tested (needs real session id); only error paths tested. Real-time is polling-based (2.5s), so tests sleep ~1.5s after sending messages before asserting UI.
rca of the issue: No bugs found; all requested features function correctly.
